name: zvideo_dd3d_upload_image_to_surface
description: zVideo_dd3d::UploadImageToSurface locks a DirectDraw upload surface, copies or converts image pixels into it, unlocks the surface, and returns success.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zVideo DD3D texture-upload source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4aa600 validates the zvid_ddd3d.c source file, fastcall uploadSurface/image with useAlpha on the stack, LockSurface_WaitRestore before pixel writes, locked lpSurface/lPitch use, useAlpha selecting ConvertImagePixelsForTexture versus raw copy, UnlockSurface_WaitRestore after the upload, and unconditional return 1.

For raw copies, assembly validates the lPitch == image->width contiguous-copy branch using ((g_zVideo_DisplayModeBpp + 7) >> 3) * width * height bytes, and the row-copy branch using ((g_zVideo_DisplayModeBpp * width + 7) >> 3) bytes per row with source rows advanced by width * 2 and destination rows advanced by lPitch.

Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x4aa600 has no warning tags. Direct callees LockSurface_WaitRestore, ConvertImagePixelsForTexture, and UnlockSurface_WaitRestore are tier C or better; memcpy is a CRT provider boundary.

The native smoke uses a fake lockable DirectDrawSurface3 and verifies lock/unlock around contiguous raw copy, row-by-row raw copy with destination padding preserved, and alpha conversion through ConvertImagePixelsForTexture.
